note: vespera_inprocess: the 422 validation_errors hoist no longer reads a JSON array (an array error element or a top-level array) as an error object. With the tracing feature the span's app field is the resolved, trimmed app name and is never recorded for an invalid or unknown name. A shared-runtime hook registered while another thread builds the runtime is no longer left waiting. vespera_jni: a header consumer that throws on a pre-dispatch error header (null stream 400, 413, setup failure, runtime unavailable, expired stash, panic fallback) now aborts the call with VesperaStreamAbortedException instead of returning normally. vespera_core: OpenApi.paths and Operation.responses are optional on deserialize (OpenAPI 3.1); a null in a type array no longer widens a schema whose enum or composition rejects null; OpenApi::merge inlines colliding pathItems references and never places a $ref next to operations. vespera: an invalid multipart enum value answers 422 like Validated and WrongFieldType (was 400). Doc and test fixes.
